data description: GPS waypoint number associated with the individual observation, multiple shells can share the same waypoint number
ID number associated with the particular GPS unit used
Site label for the observation location
Number associated with each individual ‘opihi
Observation date in MM/DD/YYYY format
Field classification of limpet exposure to solar radiation when observed, only performed for the first 67 shells
Whether the individual was observed moving
Raw shell length in inches, done for individuals 1-50
Raw shell length in tenths of a millimeter, done for individuals 51 onward
Raw shell width in inches, done for individuals 1-50
Raw shell width in tenths of a millimeter, done for individuals 51 onward
Raw shell height measured at the widest point, in inches, done for individuals 1-50
Raw shell height measured at the widest point, in tenths of a millimeter, done for individuals 51 onward
Whether there was a path to open ocean water, values are y/n
Surface angle at the observation point, in degrees
Distance to open water in feet, negative values point downward and positive values point upward
Distance to the nearest thermal shelter in feet, calculated with R in later values
Distance to under-rock shelter in feet, “toofar” used for excessive distances
Type of shelter referred to by dist_to_shelter_ft
Distance in feet to Littoraria pintado, extremophile snail used as a reference for thermal stress
Distance to living crustose coralline algae in feet
Compass bearing of the occupied surface in degrees
Compass bearing toward ocean direction in degrees
ID number of photograph(s) associated with an individual
Camera type used for photographs
Observed color and percentage of shell ribs that are that color
Estimated percent shell erosion; values listed as <1 or <5 are changed to 0.5 and 2.5 respectively in data processing
Observed color of shell inter-rib areas
Whether the rock or substrate could be moved, values are y/n
Substrate material description at the observation point
Free-text field notes, caveats, and measurement corrections
Observed percentage of limu or crustose cover on the shell, values listed as <5 and some crustose are changed to 2.5 in data processing
Microhabitat descriptor of the individual’s location on the transect
Notes about the spot on the transect
Hypotenuse measurement used for field slope geometry; distance along slope from limpet to water; units are in feet
horizontal distance from limpet to water; units are in feet
Angle associated with the field slope geometry, in degrees.
Shore type classification according to atlas
